name: Card Dispute Handling
objective: Customers get a fair, fast decision on disputed card transactions

stages.name: Intake
stages.goal: Every dispute is complete and correctly classified

steps.name: Classify fraud or dispute
rules: Unauthorised transaction goes to Fraud Investigation

stages.name: Investigation
stages.goal: The analyst has the evidence needed to decide

steps.name: Decide on provisional credit
rules: Up to EUR 2,500 without team-lead approval
No credit for accounts under 30 days old
